title: Skrill4ever
description: Hey this is a fun mod it doesnt rlly change to much abt the vanilla minecraft. It optimizes ur gameplay. But there are some things that only a good pc can handel so be carefull
body:
So this mod gives some fun extra vanilla features and optimizes ur gameplay, Some mods u will need to configurate if u dont have the strongest pc or u are woried. I will use this mod for my yt and its rlly easy to use. There is a mod menu if u wane learn abt all the mods. THere is also replay mod, betteranimations,... so yea have fun and btw its 1.21.3
